targets.notes: Hardest target. Its defining trait (co-fermentation with glucose and yeast, explicit strawberry) has no true twin. Candidates match it either on process (Вуш-Вуш, Эль Пласэр) or on descriptors (Гицумби: berries, citrus, tea finish), never both. Эль Пласэр's text describes only the process, so its cup is a guess.

general_notes: I read each 'О сорте' for explicit cup words (acidity words such as яркая/высокая/деликатная/без кислотности; body words such as плотное/мягкое/питкое; flavour family: chocolate-nut vs fruit-berry vs citrus vs spice; fermentation words) and used the process (washed / pulped natural / natural / anaerobic / co-ferment / wet-hull, robusta in blends) as a secondary signal for what is not stated. One-liners helped when they state a position ('не любит лишнюю кислотность', 'сочнейшая Кения', 'без яркой кислотности'). Thin or off-cup texts: Колумбия Декаф (only the decaf process, no cup descriptors, so never picked), Колумбия Эль Пласэр ИПА (process only; cup inferred as heavily fermented), Q-Finch (two sentences), Q-Optimistic (short). Hard cases: Мерури and Ла Сирена are unique in the set (wet-hull spice; strawberry co-ferment), so their neighbours are only partly alike. 'Softer' is often 'none' or a heavier coffee for targets already at the low-acid end, and 'brighter' is 'none' for Найваша.
